<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#08090B">
<title>Latest Limited-Time Event · AGM G-Level Referral Rewards</title>
<meta name="description" content="AGM limited-time G-level referral event: invite interns to promote movies and earn up to R2,620 per G4 invite, roulette draws and onboarding subsidies. 20–22 November.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://miaoda.feishu.cn">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://miaoda.feishu.cn/fonts/css2?family=Anton&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#08090B;
    --panel:#111318;
    --panel-2:#171A21;
    --line:rgba(245,196,81,.16);
    --gold:#F5C451;
    --gold-2:#E19B32;
    --green:#1FC98A;
    --brand:#E5342A;
    --brand-2:#F07C1D;
    --text:#F6F7F9;
    --muted:#9EA5B1;
    --radius:18px;
    --max:1120px;
    --display:'Anton','Arial Narrow',Impact,sans-serif;
    --body:'Inter','Helvetica Neue',Arial,'PingFang SC',sans-serif;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;overflow-x:hidden}
  body{
    margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--body);
    font-size:16px;line-height:1.65;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden;
  }
  img{max-width:100%;display:block}
  a{color:inherit}
  .wrap{width:100%;max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
  .gold-text{
    background:linear-gradient(100deg,#FFF1C2 0%,#F5C451 42%,#DFA033 100%);
    -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
  }

  /* ===== Top bar ===== */
  .topbar{
    position:sticky;top:0;z-index:40;
    backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
    background:rgba(8,9,11,.78);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  }
  .topbar .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:60px;gap:12px}
  .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;min-width:0}
  .brand-mark{
    width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;
    background:linear-gradient(145deg,#FBE0A1,#E19B32);color:#0A0B0D;
    font-family:var(--display);font-size:15px;letter-spacing:0;
  }
  .brand span{display:block;line-height:1.15;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .brand small{display:block;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
  .top-pill{
    font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
    border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 10px;color:var(--gold);
    white-space:nowrap;background:rgba(245,196,81,.06);
  }

  .brand-logo{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;
    padding:5px 10px;line-height:0;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.4);text-decoration:none;
  }
  .brand-logo img{height:30px;width:auto}
  .brand-logo:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #FFF3CF;outline-offset:3px}

  /* ===== Hero ===== */
  .hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
  .hero-bg{
    position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;
    background-image:url("data:image/jpeg;base64,");
    background-size:cover;background-position:78% center;
  }
  .hero-bg::after{
    content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
    background:
      radial-gradient(120% 90% at 8% 30%, rgba(8,9,11,.92) 0%, rgba(8,9,11,.78) 42%, rgba(8,9,11,.30) 78%, rgba(8,9,11,.55) 100%),
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(8,9,11,.62) 0%, rgba(8,9,11,.22) 36%, rgba(8,9,11,.92) 88%, #08090B 100%);
  }
  .hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:130px;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,9,11,0),#08090B 85%)}
  .hero-inner{position:relative;z-index:1;padding:56px 0 44px}
  .act,.closing,#activities{scroll-margin-top:76px}
  .hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px}
  .badge{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(245,196,81,.18),rgba(245,196,81,.05));
    border:1px solid rgba(245,196,81,.4);border-radius:999px;
    padding:7px 14px 7px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#FFE6B0;
  }
  .badge .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(245,196,81,.16)}
  h1{
    font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;text-transform:uppercase;
    font-size:clamp(38px,9.6vw,78px);line-height:.94;letter-spacing:.005em;
    margin:18px 0 14px;max-width:14ch;
  }
  h1 .line2{display:block}
  .hero-sub{
    font-size:clamp(15px,4.1vw,18px);color:#D3D8E0;max-width:46ch;margin:0 0 18px;
  }
  .checks{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 0 26px;display:grid;gap:9px}
  .checks li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;color:#EDF0F4}
  .checks .ck{
    width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 auto;
    background:rgba(31,201,138,.14);color:var(--green);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;
    border:1px solid rgba(31,201,138,.35);
  }
  .hero-cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-bottom:30px}
  .btn{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;
    min-height:52px;padding:0 24px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid transparent;
    font-family:var(--body);font-size:15px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.01em;
    cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease,background .18s ease;
  }
  .btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #FFF3CF;outline-offset:3px}
  .btn-primary{
    background:linear-gradient(145deg,#FBE0A1,#EFB444 55%,#D8902A);
    color:#141007;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(224,150,44,.28);
  }
  .btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(224,150,44,.36)}
  .btn-ghost{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.16);color:#F2F4F7}
  .btn-ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09)}
  .hero-stats{
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;
  }
  .stat{background:rgba(12,13,16,.82);padding:14px 12px;text-align:center}
  .stat b{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(20px,5.6vw,28px);color:var(--gold);line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:.01em}
  .stat span{display:block;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin-top:2px}

  /* countdown card */
  .countdown-card{
    background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(23,26,33,.94),rgba(13,14,18,.94));
    border:1px solid rgba(245,196,81,.22);border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:20px;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  }
  .cd-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
  .cd-label{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted)}
  .cd-period{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);white-space:nowrap}
  .cd-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px}
  .cd-cell{
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
    border-radius:12px;padding:12px 6px 10px;text-align:center;
  }
  .cd-cell b{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(24px,7.6vw,34px);line-height:1;color:#FFF6DC;letter-spacing:.02em}
  .cd-cell span{display:block;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin-top:6px}
  .cd-note{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);margin:12px 0 0;text-align:center}
  .cd-note.is-live{color:#9BEBCB}

  /* ===== Sections ===== */
  .act{padding:64px 0 0}
  .act-head{max-width:660px}
  .eyebrow{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;
    letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);
  }
  .eyebrow::before{content:"";width:22px;height:1px;background:var(--gold);opacity:.85}
  h2{
    font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;text-transform:uppercase;
    font-size:clamp(27px,6.6vw,44px);line-height:1.02;margin:10px 0 12px;letter-spacing:.01em;
  }
  .act-head p{color:#B9C0CB;font-size:15px;margin:0}

  .tier-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:26px}
  .tier{
    position:relative;background:linear-gradient(170deg,#161920,#0E1014);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:20px 20px 18px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .25s ease,border-color .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease;
  }
  .tier:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:rgba(245,196,81,.4);box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
  .tier::before{
    content:"";position:absolute;right:-40px;top:-40px;width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(245,196,81,.16),transparent 70%);pointer-events:none;
  }
  .tier-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
  .lvl{
    display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:46px;height:32px;padding:0 10px;border-radius:9px;
    font-family:var(--display);font-size:17px;letter-spacing:.03em;color:#1A1408;
    background:linear-gradient(145deg,#FBE0A1,#E5A43B);
  }
  .tag{
    font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
    border:1px solid rgba(245,196,81,.45);color:#FFDFA0;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 9px;
  }
  .tier h3{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.04em;margin:0 0 14px;text-transform:uppercase}
  .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;padding:7px 0;font-size:14px;color:#C9CFD9}
  .row b{font-family:var(--body);font-weight:700;color:#FFF2CF;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
  .total{
    margin-top:12px;padding-top:13px;border-top:1px dashed rgba(245,196,81,.28);
    display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;
  }
  .total span{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted)}
  .total strong{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(26px,7.4vw,34px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--gold)}
  .tier--top{border-color:rgba(245,196,81,.45);background:linear-gradient(165deg,#241D0F,#121216 60%)}
  .tier--top .total strong{color:#FFDD92}

  /* ===== Roulette ===== */
  .roulette-wrap{
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:30px;margin-top:26px;align-items:center;
  }
  .wheel-stage{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px}
  .draw-list{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;display:grid;gap:10px}
  .draw-list li{
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:14px;
    background:linear-gradient(170deg,#15181E,#0D0F13);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
    border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;
  }
  .draw-list .txt{font-size:14px;color:#C6CCD6}
  .draw-count{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:baseline;gap:7px;font-family:var(--display);font-size:20px;
    color:var(--gold);white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.03em;
  }
  .draw-count em{font-style:normal;font-family:var(--body);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
  .wheel-case{position:relative;width:min(360px,84vw);aspect-ratio:1/1;display:grid;place-items:center}
  .wheel-glow{
    position:absolute;inset:4%;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(14px);
    background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(229,52,42,.38),rgba(240,124,29,.16) 55%,transparent 74%);
  }
  .wheel-pointer{
    position:absolute;top:-6px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:3;
    width:0;height:0;border-left:12px solid transparent;border-right:12px solid transparent;
    border-top:22px solid var(--gold);filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 14px rgba(245,196,81,.55));
  }
  .wheel-disc{
    position:relative;z-index:1;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;
    filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.55));
  }
  .wheel-img{
    position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;
    animation:wheelSpin 26s linear infinite;will-change:transform;
  }
  .wheel-case.paused .wheel-img{animation-play-state:paused}
  @keyframes wheelSpin{from{transform:rotate(0)}to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
  .wheel-toggle{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);color:#E7EBF0;border-radius:999px;
    padding:7px 14px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;
    font-family:var(--body);cursor:pointer;min-height:36px;
  }
  .wheel-toggle:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
  .wheel-toggle:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #FFF3CF;outline-offset:3px}
  .wheel-toggle .ico{color:var(--gold);font-size:10px;line-height:1}
  .wheel-note{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;max-width:36ch;margin:0}
  .wheel-note b{color:#D8DEE7;font-weight:600}
  .prize-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;justify-content:center;max-width:420px;margin-top:2px}
  .prize{
    font-family:var(--display);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.03em;color:#FFDFA0;
    border:1px solid rgba(245,196,81,.3);background:rgba(245,196,81,.07);
    border-radius:999px;padding:5px 11px;white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .prize--dbl{color:#FFC8B4;border-color:rgba(229,52,42,.4);background:rgba(229,52,42,.1)}

  /* ===== Allowance / upgrade ===== */
  .grid-4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:26px}
  .grid-3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:26px}
  .money-card{
    background:linear-gradient(170deg,#161920,#0D0F13);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);
    border-radius:var(--radius);padding:18px 16px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    transition:border-color .25s ease,transform .25s ease;
  }
  .money-card:hover{border-color:rgba(31,201,138,.4);transform:translateY(-2px)}
  .money-card .lvl{height:28px;min-width:42px;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:12px}
  .money-card .label{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
  .money-card .amount{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(30px,8.4vw,42px);line-height:1;margin:6px 0 8px;color:#9DEFCE}
  .money-card .meta{font-size:12.5px;color:#B4BBC6;margin:0}
  .money-card--gold .amount{color:var(--gold)}
  .chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-top:10px}
  .chip{
    font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:999px;
    background:rgba(245,196,81,.10);border:1px solid rgba(245,196,81,.34);color:#FFD98F;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .chip--green{background:rgba(31,201,138,.12);border-color:rgba(31,201,138,.4);color:#8FEBC5}
  .note-inline{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start;margin-top:16px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
  .note-inline .i{color:var(--gold);font-weight:800}

  /* ===== Steps ===== */
  .steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:26px}
  .step{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;padding:18px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:var(--radius);background:rgba(255,255,255,.02)}
  .step .num{font-family:var(--display);font-size:26px;color:var(--gold);line-height:1;flex:0 0 auto}
  .step h4{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#F2F5F8}
  .step p{margin:0;font-size:13.5px;color:#AEB6C2}

  /* ===== Closing ===== */
  .closing{
    margin-top:64px;padding:52px 0 56px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(245,196,81,.09),rgba(8,9,11,0) 70%);
    border-top:1px solid rgba(245,196,81,.18);
  }
  .closing-inner{
    background:linear-gradient(160deg,#1B1E26,#0B0C0F 65%);
    border:1px solid rgba(245,196,81,.3);border-radius:24px;padding:30px 22px;text-align:center;
    box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.5);position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  }
  .closing-inner::before{
    content:"";position:absolute;top:-90px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
    width:340px;height:200px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(245,196,81,.3),transparent 70%);
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .closing h2{font-size:clamp(26px,7vw,42px);margin:12px 0 14px;position:relative}
  .closing p.lead{color:#DFE4EA;font-size:15.5px;max-width:54ch;margin:0 auto 24px;position:relative}
  .closing .hero-cta{justify-content:center;margin-bottom:14px}
  .closing .small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:0}

  /* terms */
  .terms{padding:30px 0 110px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
  .terms h5{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 12px;font-weight:800}
  .terms ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px;color:#8F97A3;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.75}
  .terms li{margin-bottom:5px}
  .foot-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:22px;color:#6F7681;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.06em}

  /* sticky mobile CTA */
  .sticky-cta{
    position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:50;display:flex;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,9,11,0),rgba(8,9,11,.92) 30%);
    backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
    transform:translateY(110%);transition:transform .3s ease;
  }
  .sticky-cta.show{transform:translateY(0)}
  .sticky-cta .btn{flex:1;min-height:48px;font-size:14px;padding:0 14px}

  /* toast */
  .toast{
    position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:96px;transform:translate(-50%,16px);z-index:60;
    background:#FFF4D6;color:#1A1408;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 16px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;
    box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.5);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s ease,transform .25s ease;
    max-width:calc(100% - 32px);text-align:center;
  }
  .toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}

  /* reveal */
  .js .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:opacity .6s ease,transform .6s ease}
  .js .reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}

  @media (max-width:719px){
    .brand-logo{padding:4px 8px}
    .brand-logo img{height:26px}
    .hero-inner{padding-top:44px}
    .hero-bg{background-position:72% center}
    .hero-bg::after{
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(8,9,11,.86) 0%, rgba(8,9,11,.72) 38%, rgba(8,9,11,.55) 62%, rgba(8,9,11,.94) 92%, #08090B 100%),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(8,9,11,.8), rgba(8,9,11,.2));
    }
  }
  @media (min-width:720px){
    .hero-inner{padding:76px 0 60px}
    .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1.28fr .72fr;gap:44px;align-items:end}
    .cd-grid{gap:10px}
    .tier-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:16px}
    .grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
    .grid-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
    .roulette-wrap{grid-template-columns:minmax(280px,360px) 1fr;gap:44px}
    .steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
    .act{padding:84px 0 0}
    .closing-inner{padding:52px 48px}
    .topbar .wrap{height:66px}
  }
  @media (min-width:1000px){
    .wheel-holder{width:340px}
  }
  @media (min-width:900px){
    .sticky-cta{display:none}
    .terms{padding-bottom:60px}
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
    .js .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}
    .wheel{transition:transform .8s ease}
    .tier:hover,.money-card:hover,.btn-primary:hover{transform:none}
    .sticky-cta{transition:none}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ===== 顶部栏 ===== -->
<header class="topbar">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="brand-logo">
      <img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Allied Global Marketing (AGM)" width="82" height="43">
    </div>
    <div class="top-pill">Limited Time · 11.20–22</div>
  </div>
</header>

<!-- ===== Hero ===== -->
<section class="hero">
  <div class="hero-bg" role="img" aria-label="Golden reward boxes, coins and celebrating team"></div>
  <div class="hero-inner">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="hero-grid">
        <div>
          <div class="badge"><span class="dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>Latest Limited-Time Event</div>
          <h1>Invite Interns.<span class="line2 gold-text">Earn Rand.</span></h1>
          <p class="hero-sub">Four reward activities. Every G-level pays more. Invite today, get paid when your intern joins.</p>
          <ul class="checks">
            <li><span class="ck" aria-hidden="true">✓</span>Efficient Fulfillment</li>
            <li><span class="ck" aria-hidden="true">✓</span>Generous Subsidies</li>
            <li><span class="ck" aria-hidden="true">✓</span>Win-win value</li>
          </ul>
          <div class="hero-cta">
            <a class="btn btn-primary" href="#activities">Invite &amp; Earn Now <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
            <a class="btn btn-ghost js-wa" href="#" data-msg="hero">Share on WhatsApp</a>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="countdown-card" aria-labelledby="cd-title">
          <div class="cd-head">
            <span class="cd-label" id="cd-title">Event ends in</span>
            <span class="cd-period">11.20 – 11.22</span>
          </div>
          <div class="cd-grid" id="cd">
            <div class="cd-cell"><b id="cd-d">00</b><span>Days</span></div>
            <div class="cd-cell"><b id="cd-h">00</b><span>Hours</span></div>
            <div class="cd-cell"><b id="cd-m">00</b><span>Mins</span></div>
            <div class="cd-cell"><b id="cd-s">00</b><span>Secs</span></div>
          </div>
          <p class="cd-note is-live" id="cd-note">Event is live — rewards are being issued now.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="hero-stats" style="margin-top:38px">
        <div class="stat"><b>R2,620</b><span>Max total per G4 invite</span></div>
        <div class="stat"><b>6 Draws</b><span>Per G4 invite</span></div>
        <div class="stat"><b>R800</b><span>Onboarding subsidy</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<main id="activities">

  <!-- ===== Activity 1 ===== -->
  <section class="act" id="act1">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="act-head reveal">
        <span class="eyebrow">Activity 01</span>
        <h2>Invite Rand Reward</h2>
        <p>Invite an intern to join at any G-level. You get a referral reward plus an activity reward — paid in Rand.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="tier-grid">
        <article class="tier reveal">
          <div class="tier-top"><span class="lvl">G1</span></div>
          <h3>Invite an intern to join G1</h3>
          <div class="row"><span>Referral Reward</span><b>R54</b></div>
          <div class="row"><span>Activity Reward</span><b>R50</b></div>
          <div class="total"><span>Total Reward</span><strong>R104</strong></div>
        </article>

        <article class="tier reveal">
          <div class="tier-top"><span class="lvl">G2</span></div>
          <h3>Invite an intern to join G2</h3>
          <div class="row"><span>Referral Reward</span><b>R216</b></div>
          <div class="row"><span>Activity Reward</span><b>R220</b></div>
          <div class="total"><span>Total Reward</span><strong>R436</strong></div>
        </article>

        <article class="tier reveal">
          <div class="tier-top"><span class="lvl">G3</span></div>
          <h3>Invite an intern to join G3</h3>
          <div class="row"><span>Referral Reward</span><b>R540</b></div>
          <div class="row"><span>Activity Reward</span><b>R550</b></div>
          <div class="total"><span>Total Reward</span><strong>R1,090</strong></div>
        </article>

        <article class="tier tier--top reveal">
          <div class="tier-top"><span class="lvl">G4</span><span class="tag">Top reward</span></div>
          <h3>Invite an intern to join G4</h3>
          <div class="row"><span>Referral Reward</span><b>R1,620</b></div>
          <div class="row"><span>Activity Reward</span><b>R1,000</b></div>
          <div class="total"><span>Total Reward</span><strong>R2,620</strong></div>
        </article>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ===== Activity 2 ===== -->
  <section class="act" id="act2">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="act-head reveal">
        <span class="eyebrow">Activity 02</span>
        <h2>Invite Roulette Rewards</h2>
        <p>Every intern who joins earns you draws on the official AGM reward wheel. Higher level, more draws.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="roulette-wrap">
        <div class="wheel-stage reveal">
          <div class="wheel-case" id="wheelCase">
            <div class="wheel-glow" aria-hidden="true"></div>
            <div class="wheel-pointer" aria-hidden="true"></div>
            <div class="wheel-disc"><img class="wheel-img" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="AGM reward wheel with cash prizes, coupons and double rewards" width="640" height="640"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="prize-row" aria-label="Prizes on the AGM reward wheel">
            <span class="prize">R20</span><span class="prize">R30</span><span class="prize">R50</span>
            <span class="prize">R80</span><span class="prize">R100</span><span class="prize">R200</span>
            <span class="prize">R800</span><span class="prize">R10,000</span>
            <span class="prize prize--dbl">Coupon</span><span class="prize prize--dbl">Double</span>
          </div>
          <button class="wheel-toggle" id="wheelToggle" type="button" aria-pressed="false">
            <span class="ico" aria-hidden="true">⏸</span><span class="txt">Pause rotation</span>
          </button>
          <p class="wheel-note">Official AGM reward wheel, rotating automatically. Draws are issued by G-level — see below.</p>
        </div>

        <ul class="draw-list reveal">
          <li><span class="lvl">G1</span><span class="txt">Invite an intern to join</span><span class="draw-count">1 <em>Draw</em></span></li>
          <li><span class="lvl">G2</span><span class="txt">Invite an intern to join</span><span class="draw-count">2 <em>Draws</em></span></li>
          <li><span class="lvl">G3</span><span class="txt">Invite an intern to join</span><span class="draw-count">3 <em>Draws</em></span></li>
          <li><span class="lvl">G4</span><span class="txt">Invite an intern to join</span><span class="draw-count">6 <em>Draws</em></span></li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ===== Activity 3 ===== -->
  <section class="act" id="act3">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="act-head reveal">
        <span class="eyebrow">Activity 03</span>
        <h2>Intern Onboarding Allowance</h2>
        <p>Your invited intern also gets a joining subsidy — paid the moment they start at their G-level.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="grid-4">
        <div class="money-card reveal">
          <span class="lvl">G1</span>
          <div class="label">Onboarding subsidy</div>
          <div class="amount">R30</div>
          <p class="meta">Intern joins at G1</p>
        </div>
        <div class="money-card reveal">
          <span class="lvl">G2</span>
          <div class="label">Onboarding subsidy</div>
          <div class="amount">R150</div>
          <p class="meta">Intern joins at G2</p>
        </div>
        <div class="money-card reveal">
          <span class="lvl">G3</span>
          <div class="label">Onboarding subsidy</div>
          <div class="amount">R300</div>
          <p class="meta">Intern joins at G3</p>
        </div>
        <div class="money-card reveal">
          <span class="lvl">G4</span>
          <div class="label">Onboarding subsidy</div>
          <div class="amount">R800</div>
          <p class="meta">Intern joins at G4</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p class="note-inline"><span class="i" aria-hidden="true">i</span><span>This subsidy goes to the intern, on top of your own referral reward.</span></p>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ===== Activity 4 ===== -->
  <section class="act" id="act4">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="act-head reveal">
        <span class="eyebrow">Activity 04</span>
        <h2>G-Level Upgrade Subsidy</h2>
        <p>When your intern moves up a level during the event, you get a cash subsidy plus extra draws.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="grid-3">
        <div class="money-card money-card--gold reveal">
          <span class="lvl">G2</span>
          <div class="label">Upgrade subsidy</div>
          <div class="amount">R150</div>
          <div class="chips"><span class="chip">+1 Draw</span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="money-card money-card--gold reveal">
          <span class="lvl">G3</span>
          <div class="label">Upgrade subsidy</div>
          <div class="amount">R300</div>
          <div class="chips"><span class="chip">+3 Draws</span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="money-card money-card--gold reveal">
          <span class="lvl">G4</span>
          <div class="label">Upgrade subsidy</div>
          <div class="amount">R800</div>
          <div class="chips"><span class="chip">+6 Draws</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p class="note-inline"><span class="i" aria-hidden="true">i</span><span>Upgrade subsidies stack on top of your Activity 01 reward — one subsidy each time your intern reaches a new level during the event.</span></p>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ===== Steps ===== -->
  <section class="act" id="how">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="act-head reveal">
        <span class="eyebrow">How it works</span>
        <h2>Three Steps to Your Reward</h2>
      </div>
      <div class="steps">
        <div class="step reveal"><div class="num">01</div><div><h4>Invite your friend</h4><p>Send your invite link to anyone who wants to promote movies.</p></div></div>
        <div class="step reveal"><div class="num">02</div><div><h4>Friend joins a G-level</h4><p>They join at G1–G4 and pass onboarding. Your reward and draws are issued.</p></div></div>
        <div class="step reveal"><div class="num">03</div><div><h4>Keep earning on upgrades</h4><p>Every level they climb adds another subsidy and more draws to you.</p></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ===== Closing ===== -->
  <section class="closing">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="closing-inner reveal">
        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:18px"><span class="brand-logo"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Allied Global Marketing (AGM)" width="82" height="43"></span></div>
        <span class="badge"><span class="dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>Event Period · 11.20 – 11.22</span>
        <h2>Invite Friends. <span class="gold-text">Promote the Movie.</span> Get Paid.</h2>
        <p class="lead">Successfully invite friends to promote the movie and unlock high commissions and generous rewards waiting for you!</p>
        <div class="hero-cta">
          <a class="btn btn-primary js-wa" href="#" data-msg="main">Invite on WhatsApp <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
          <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="copyBtn" type="button">Copy invite link</button>
        </div>
        <p class="small">Limited-time event. Rewards are in South African Rand (R).</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ===== Terms ===== -->
  <section class="terms">
    <div class="wrap">
      <h5>Event notes</h5>
      <ul>
        <li>Event Period: 20 November – 22 November. Rewards are counted for invites and level-ups that happen inside this period.</li>
        <li>All amounts are in South African Rand (R). Activity 01 total = Referral Reward + Activity Reward.</li>
        <li>Rewards are issued once the invited intern successfully joins at the matching G-level and completes onboarding.</li>
        <li>Each intern counts once per reward activity. Upgrade subsidies apply when the intern moves up to the stated level during the event.</li>
        <li>Draws come from Activity 02 and Activity 04, and are taken on the official AGM reward wheel shown on this page.</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="foot-brand">
        <span class="brand-logo" style="padding:3px 7px"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Allied Global Marketing (AGM)" width="60" height="31"></span>
        <span>Allied Global Marketing · G-Level Referral Event · All rewards in ZAR</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<!-- ===== Sticky mobile CTA ===== -->
<div class="sticky-cta" id="stickyCta">
  <a class="btn btn-ghost" href="#act1">See rewards</a>
  <a class="btn btn-primary js-wa" href="#" data-msg="main">Invite now</a>
</div>

<div class="toast" id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>

<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";
  document.documentElement.classList.add("js");

  /* ---------- Countdown ---------- */
  var START = new Date(2026, 10, 20, 0, 0, 0);
  var END   = new Date(2026, 10, 22, 23, 59, 59);
  var cdD = document.getElementById("cd-d"), cdH = document.getElementById("cd-h"),
      cdM = document.getElementById("cd-m"), cdS = document.getElementById("cd-s"),
      cdNote = document.getElementById("cd-note");
  var pad = function(n){ return (n < 10 ? "0" : "") + n; };

  function tick(){
    var now = new Date();
    var diff, note, state;
    if (now < START){
      diff = START - now; state = "upcoming";
      note = "Event starts in — get your invite list ready.";
      document.querySelector(".cd-label").textContent = "Event starts in";
    } else if (now > END){
      diff = 0; state = "ended";
      note = "This event has ended. Thank you for joining.";
      document.querySelector(".cd-label").textContent = "Event ended";
    } else {
      diff = END - now; state = "live";
      note = "Event is live — rewards are being issued now.";
      document.querySelector(".cd-label").textContent = "Event ends in";
    }
    var d = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);
    var h = Math.floor(diff % 86400000 / 3600000);
    var m = Math.floor(diff % 3600000 / 60000);
    var s = Math.floor(diff % 60000 / 1000);
    cdD.textContent = pad(d); cdH.textContent = pad(h);
    cdM.textContent = pad(m); cdS.textContent = pad(s);
    cdNote.textContent = note;
    cdNote.classList.toggle("is-live", state === "live");
  }
  tick(); setInterval(tick, 1000);

  /* ---------- Reveal on scroll ---------- */
  var revealEls = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".reveal"));
  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window){
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(e){
        if (e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add("in"); io.unobserve(e.target); }
      });
    }, { rootMargin: "0px 0px -8% 0px", threshold: 0.12 });
    revealEls.forEach(function(el, i){
      el.style.transitionDelay = Math.min(i % 4, 3) * 0.06 + "s";
      io.observe(el);
    });
  } else {
    revealEls.forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add("in"); });
  }

  /* ---------- Auto-rotating wheel ---------- */
  var wheelCase = document.getElementById("wheelCase");
  var wheelToggle = document.getElementById("wheelToggle");
  var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  var wheelPaused = false;

  function setWheelPaused(paused){
    wheelPaused = paused;
    wheelCase.classList.toggle("paused", paused);
    wheelToggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", paused ? "true" : "false");
    wheelToggle.querySelector(".ico").textContent = paused ? "▶" : "⏸";
    wheelToggle.querySelector(".txt").textContent = paused ? "Resume rotation" : "Pause rotation";
  }
  if (reduceMotion) setWheelPaused(true);
    wheelToggle.addEventListener("click", function(){ setWheelPaused(!wheelPaused); });

  /* ---------- Toast ---------- */
  var toast = document.getElementById("toast");
  var toastTimer;
  function showToast(msg){
    toast.textContent = msg;
    toast.classList.add("show");
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(function(){ toast.classList.remove("show"); }, 2400);
  }

  /* ---------- Copy link ---------- */
  var copyBtn = document.getElementById("copyBtn");
  copyBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
    var url = location.href;
    var done = function(){ showToast("Invite link copied — paste it to your friend."); };
    var fail = function(){
      var tmp = document.createElement("input");
      tmp.value = url; document.body.appendChild(tmp);
      tmp.select();
      try { document.execCommand("copy"); done(); }
      catch(e){ showToast("Copy not available. Long-press the page link to copy."); }
      document.body.removeChild(tmp);
    };
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext){
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(done).catch(fail);
    } else { fail(); }
  });

  /* ---------- WhatsApp share ---------- */
  var shareText = "🔥 Latest Limited-Time Event (Nov 20–22): invite interns to promote movies and earn up to R2,620 per G4 invite + up to 6 lucky draws + R800 onboarding subsidy. Join here: ";
  var waLinks = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".js-wa"));
  waLinks.forEach(function(a){
    a.href = "https://wa.me/?text=" + encodeURIComponent(shareText + location.href);
    a.target = "_blank";
    a.rel = "noopener";
  });

  /* ---------- Sticky CTA ---------- */
  var sticky = document.getElementById("stickyCta");
  var onScroll = function(){
    sticky.classList.toggle("show", window.scrollY > 480);
  };
  window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });
  onScroll();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
